projectEvidence.prompt: Inspect intended apex, aliases, application/API and reserved hosts.
Inspect authoritative DNS ownership, current non-secret records and TTL.
Inspect exact public/private roots and unrelated hosted projects.
Inspect certificate coverage, redirect owners and prior rollback values.

projectChanges.description: Adapt the hostname and public/private root worksheets.
Record scoped DNS and rollback values.
Adapt only the approved alias redirect after TLS verification.

externalActions.effect: Change only the approved DNS records.
externalActions.rollback: Restore prior record values and observe TTL.

externalActions.effect: Create or edit the approved hosting mapping.
externalActions.verification: Confirm scoped root and unrelated-site baselines.

externalActions.effect: Request/verify certificate coverage and enable the approved redirect owner.
externalActions.verification: Valid TLS and finite canonical path/query redirects.
externalActions.rollback: Restore prior routing and known-good TLS destination.

approvalGates.scope: Change only the approved DNS records. Target: <HOSTNAME> in <AUTHORITATIVE_ZONE>
Create or edit the approved hosting mapping. Target: <HOSTNAME> at <DOCUMENT_ROOT>
Request/verify certificate coverage and enable the approved redirect owner. Target: <HOSTNAME>

checks.instruction: Compare authoritative and recursive DNS against the approved target.
Inspect TLS coverage for canonical and alias hostnames without bypass.
Adapt kit/checks/dns-tls-routing.md and compare first responses plus finite chains.
checks.expected: Path/query preservation and unchanged unrelated projects.

rollback.instruction: Restore selected prior DNS records after explicit recovery approval.
rollback.verification: Observe authoritative/recursive results through recorded TTL.

rollback.instruction: Restore scoped domain mapping and prior redirect rules with approval.
rollback.verification: Recheck all selected and unrelated hosted surfaces.

acceptance.criterion: All approved hostname targets and certificate coverage verified.
Owner accepts finite routing and recoverable prior mappings.
